checks_passed.what_was_verified: Reopened p04 and confirmed the [0003] tembotrione and tefuryltrione SMILES atom by atom against the drawings: benzoyl cyclohexane-1,3-dione, Cl at 2, CH2-O-CH2CF3 or CH2-O-CH2-(tetrahydrofuran-2-yl) at 3, methanesulfonyl at 4, and no stereo bond on the drawn tetrahydrofuran ring. Both molecular formulae match. Substituent positions were read off the page, not inferred.

Reopened p06 and confirmed the [0025] structure is a single symmetrical ether of two 2-chloro-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid units joined through their 3-methylene groups, matching the aliased SMILES ring system and all four substituent positions on each ring. No second structure is drawn there, so the vision read's single-molecule list is correct and the benzyl alcohol named in the same sentence genuinely has no drawn structure.

Reopened p11 and p13 for the two drawing-only base records. p11 [0092] really letters CF3CH2OH and C4H9ONa above the arrow and HCl below it, and really draws the reactant as the potassium salt, against prose that says potassium tert-butoxide and sodium salt. p13 [0111] really letters NaOH above the arrow, against prose that says sodium tert-butoxide. Both vision reads are correct and both records carry notes recording the conflict rather than resolving it, so neither is a fabrication.

Reopened p10, p19 and p20 for the counter-ion conflicts. p10 [0085] draws the potassium salt where the prose says sodium; p19 [0181] draws the sodium salt with a tetrahydrofuran-2-yl-CH2-OK reagent; p19 [0187] draws the sodium salt with the ONa reagent; p20 [0193] draws the sodium salt with the OK reagent. Every one matches its IMAGE_EXTRACT, including which letters are inked in. In all twenty-two schemes checked, reagents above the arrow were kept separate from those below it, and the prior-art scheme at [0008] is annotated under Background, not as the invention's route.

Recomputed mass times purity divided by molecular weight against the recorded mmol for all 53 records that carry both mass_g and mmol. Forty-nine agree within 5 percent. The only four that do not are the four purity_pct nulls reported above, so no other unit or scale error is present. Volume charges were checked separately: all 61 volume_ml values match the printed millilitres, with no mL to L confusion.

Closed the yield for all twenty examples. Product mass times HPLC content divided by 346.70 for the trifluoroethoxy acid or 348.79 for the tetrahydrofurfuryloxy acid reproduces the printed two-step yield on 0.1 mol of the methyl ester to within 0.5 percentage points in every example, the largest gaps being Example 2 (92.85 computed against 92.4 printed) and Example 8 (92.34 against 91.9). These are the patent's own rounding, not artifact errors, and the recorded yield_pct matches the printed figure in all twenty cases. Step to step continuity holds: every example charges 0.1 mol of the step (1) salt into step (2), which is what step (1) produces from 0.1 mol of ester.

Every one of the 280 provenance entries was checked mechanically: the identifier aligns 1:1 with the record at the same index, quote_zh appears verbatim in the cited source line after whitespace and full-width punctuation normalisation for all 280, no entry has an empty source_lines, and no entry cites a line outside its own section for any of the twenty example sections. Nothing in the artifact is unanchored, and no invented condition, molecular weight, formula or InChI key appears in any record.

Compared every Chinese alias against its English identifier for all 280 records. All follow the Chinese, including the ones where a wrong reading was available: 硝磺草酮 to mesotrione, 环磺酮 to tembotrione and not fenquinotrione, 呋喃磺草酮 to tefuryltrione, 叔戊醇 to tert-amyl alcohol and not tert-pentanol confusion, 2-甲基-2-戊醇 to 2-methyl-2-pentanol, 2-四氢呋喃甲醇 to tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol, 双接杂质 to double-attachment impurity, 二苄醚类化合物 to a class name kept unresolved. The patent's own typo at [0032] and [0039], where the Chinese says potassium hydroxide is made up as an aqueous sodium hydroxide solution, is reproduced faithfully by the EN lines and touches no record.

All 963 tags across the 280 records are of the form category:value with a lowercase snake_case ASCII value and no stray characters; the four categories used are functional_group, compound_class, chemical_family and hazard. No record has a null or empty tag list. identifier_type takes only iupac, trivial_name, other and functional_ref; role takes only product, solvent, reactant, base, acid, other, by_product and reagent; section_type takes only the nine expected section kinds.

No record carries id, compound_uuid, any other *_uuid, an embedding or any other enrichment or vector field. The smiles key is present on 89 records and null on every one of them, and structures read off the drawings are carried in aliases as the brief requires. Every record has patent_id, identifier, identifier_type, aliases, section_label, section_type, role, tags and notes populated.

The compounds artifact defines no precursor_step or linkage_confirmed field, so there is no linkage claim to substantiate or to leave null. Step to step continuity was instead checked through the arithmetic above.

Walked all twenty-nine sections against the source. Solvents, washes and drying steps were checked explicitly rather than skimmed: every tertiary alcohol charge, every step (2) solvent (acetonitrile, DMF, DMSO, THF), the 120 mL water dilution and the concentrated hydrochloric acid acidification are present in all twenty examples, and Example 10's two-solvent step (1) charge is recorded as separate 50 mL and 150 mL records. Nothing was dried over a drying agent and no wash solvent other than water is printed, so there is no missing wash or drying agent. Beyond the omissions reported above, the only entities in the text with no record are HPPD, the triketone, pyrazolone and isoxazolone class names, the benzyl bromide functional group and the cited patent numbers, none of which is a compound.
